IDC today released a report pointing out that Huawei and Apple are the only smartphone manufacturers that recorded shipment growth in the Chinese market in the second quarter of 2026. Details are as follows.

The results mark the fifth consecutive quarter of year-on-year decline

According to the report, among major smartphone manufacturers in China in the second quarter of 2026, Apple recorded the strongest year-on-year shipment growth, with an increase of 24.4%.

This growth propelled Apple from fifth to second place, with market share climbing from 13.9% to 18.1%. Huawei continued to hold its leading position in the market, accounting for 22.6% of smartphone shipments during the quarter.

That said, all other major smartphone manufacturers recorded year-on-year declines, with shipments falling by as much as 60.8% amid rising memory and component costs, reduced government subsidies, and weaker consumer demand (particularly during the 618 shopping festival).

Overall, the Chinese smartphone market declined 4.3% year-on-year, with shipments of approximately 66 million units during the quarter.
